epics.sixSigmaMetric: Defect escape rate for Moodle integration
requirements: R1: Implement Moodle SSO integration as specified in the client brief.
R2: Implement role synchronization with the Moodle system.
R4: Implement fallback resilience for Moodle authentication.

slices.title: Implement Moodle integration findings
slices.jtbd: When implementing Moodle integration findings for this epic, I want to ensure SSO, role synchronization, access control, and fallback resilience are completely resolved, so that the missing specifications are properly implemented.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a user attempts to log in,
When they choose Moodle SSO,
Then they are authenticated via Moodle and their roles are synchronized.
Given the Moodle system is temporarily unavailable,
When a user attempts to log in,
Then fallback resilience mechanisms are triggered to allow autonomous access.
